header: PER ONE LAKH OF POPULATION IN INDIA DURING 1976

notes: Volume of Suicides in States, Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities

The volume of suicides per lakh of population for India as a whole was 6.79, for the States as a whole 6.77, and for the Union Territories as a whole it was 8.33. The volume of suicides for Union Territories was higher than the States and the all-India average. Among States, the volume of suicides per lakh of population ranged between 24.55 to 0.90.
